brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates a nuanced correction of the caregiver's glucose misunderstanding (HO1), surfaces multiple non-volunteered case facts from workspace queries (HO2), provides symptom/measurement-gated conditional pathways for both high and low glucose (HO3), and translates complex hospital information into a practical caregiver checklist with concrete questions and fall precautions (HO4). All eight responsibility-chain items are met without error, and closure is safe, traceable, and executable with caregiver teach-back. No important non-chain defect is present.
